description: Imposes a FALLING amplitude envelope over each group of cyclecnt wavecycles (submode 2) - waveset-rate amplitude modulation locked to the source's own zero crossings, so the 'tremolo' rate tracks the source pitch. Duration static and SAMPLE-EXACT on every probe (tones, flat noise, all parameter shapes). Sibling submodes share the argv: 1 = rising envelope, 3 = troughed (troughing becomes a REQUIRED positional), 4 = user envelope from a datafile ('distort envel 4 in out envfile cyclecnt') - reachable via execute() or later entries. All three parameters are breakpoint-capable (each verified against both scalar endpoints). Deterministic. MONO only.
musical_use: Pitch-tracking granular AM: each group of cycles gets a percussive decay, turning sustained material into a stream of plucked/struck grains whose repetition rate is the source frequency divided by cyclecnt. Small cyclecnt (1-5) adds a hard, buzzy edge (near ring-mod roughness); mid values (10-50) read as measured tremolo/stutter; large values chop the sound into discrete falling events. exponent shapes the grain (high = snappier attack decay), troughing sets how deep the envelope cuts (default all the way to silence). Breakpoint cyclecnt to accelerate the stutter across the file. Submode 1 (rising) gives reversed-feeling grains; submode 3 adds controllable trough depth as a positional.

cyclecnt.description: Wavecycles under each envelope (CDP-enforced 1-1000: 0 and 40000 refused 'out of range (1.000000 to 1000.000000)' - note the much smaller ceiling than most waveset params). Breakpoint-capable, banner-confirmed and verified (5->60 ramp differs from both endpoint renders).

troughing.description: Floor of the envelope, 0-1 (CDP-enforced; 1.5 refused verbatim; default 0 = decays to silence). Higher values shallow the modulation. Breakpoint-capable (0->0.9 ramp verified against both endpoints).

exponent.description: Envelope decay curvature (CDP-enforced 0.02-50: 0 and 60 refused verbatim; omitted = linear, i.e. 1). >1 decays faster (snappier grains), <1 slower. Breakpoint-capable (0.5->4 ramp verified against both endpoints).

examples.description: Plucked-grain tremolo at the source's pitch / 20.
examples.expected_use: A 440 Hz source stutters at ~22 Hz; same output length, each grain decays linearly to silence.
Grain rate rises across the file while high exponent keeps each grain percussive.

known_issues: Submode is load-bearing: 1 = rising, 2 = falling (this entry), 3 = troughed with a REQUIRED troughing positional (different argv shape), 4 = user envelope file. Submode 4's datafile goes AFTER the output path ('distort envel 4 in out envfile cyclecnt'); putting it before the outfile fails with 'Cannot open output file ...'.

Unipolar (zero-crossing-free) material is ACCEPTED here - the whole file reads as very few giant wavesets, output stays full length (verified 88200 frames on a positive-only click train) - unlike most waveset distorts which refuse it.
Stereo refused: 'Application doesn't work with this type of infile.' (exit 255) -> mono.
Deterministic; duration sample-exact in all 17 probe runs.
